envelope.description: Add the status read to the tracker port and the GitHub adapter

body.title: Add the status read to the tracker port and the GitHub adapter
body.summary: Add the 'status-read' capability to the Capability union, to ALL_CAPABILITIES (so missingCapabilities reports it) and to the GitHub adapter's declared set; add the optional async readIssueStatus(issue) to TrackerPort and implement it in the GitHub adapter over the registry table's ghGetIssueState, mapping a GhCommandError to a port failure kind and rethrowing a ToolDenied. Update the tests that pin the capability set (port.test.ts, github-adapter.test.ts).
acceptanceChecks: the adapter declares status-read and readIssueStatus returns { state, labels } for an issue
a port without the capability is reported by missingCapabilities and loadTracker rejects it when status-read is needed
a missing tool, a signed-out gh and a timeout map to the port failure kinds and a denied call is rethrown

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/port.test.ts: missingCapabilities reports status-read for a declared set without it
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: readIssueStatus maps the gh issue view output to state and labels and the adapter declares status-read

src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/github-adapter.test.ts: readIssueStatus maps a gh timeout to unreachable, a missing gh to missing-tool and a signed-out gh to missing-signin, and is cancelled by the Deadline signal
